skill.name: hmdb-database
skill.description: Access Human Metabolome Database (220K+ metabolites). Search by name/ID/structure, retrieve chemical properties, biomarker data, NMR/MS spectra, pathways, for metabolomics and identification.
skill.summary: Guide metabolomics research with HMDB metabolite search, spectra, biomarkers, pathways, and downloadable data fields.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Metabolomics work often needs trusted metabolite identifiers, spectra, concentrations, and pathway context. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through HMDB searches, downloads, fields, and workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches by metabolite name, synonym, HMDB identifier, structure, mass, specimen type, disease, and pathway.
Explains HMDB data fields for chemical properties, taxonomy, concentrations, spectra, pathways, enzymes, and external database links.
Supports metabolite identification workflows using MS, MS-MS, LC-MS, GC-MS, and NMR reference data.
Describes bulk download formats including XML, SDF, FASTA, TXT, CSV, and TSV.
Highlights HMDB usage requirements, citation expectations, and commercial access limits.
limitations: HMDB does not provide a public REST API according to the skill documentation.
Some fields are incomplete across metabolite records, especially spectra and kinetic data.
The skill provides research guidance and does not validate clinical decisions.
Commercial use of HMDB data may require explicit permission from the database team.

use_cases.title: Identify Unknown Metabolites
use_cases.description: Match experimental spectra, molecular weight, and structure clues against HMDB reference data.

use_cases.title: Review Biomarker Evidence
use_cases.description: Find disease associations, normal concentration ranges, specimen locations, and supporting references for candidate biomarkers.

use_cases.title: Prepare Local Data Integration
use_cases.description: Select HMDB download formats and fields for building internal metabolite reference tables.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Metabolite
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup by name or HMDB identifier.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HMDB database skill to look up this metabolite: [name or HMDB ID]. Summarize identifiers, formula, molecular weight, specimen locations, and main biological roles.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Matches
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate metabolite identification from analytical evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HMDB guidance to compare these candidate metabolites: [list]. Evaluate mass, spectra availability, specimen type, pathways, and biological plausibility.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Biomarker Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of disease and concentration evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HMDB fields to assess whether [metabolite] is a credible biomarker for [condition]. Include disease links, normal and abnormal concentrations, specimen type, references, and caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for local HMDB integration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an HMDB data integration plan for [project]. Recommend download formats, fields to extract, version tracking, identifier mapping, quality checks, and citation handling.

output_examples.input: Look up glucose in HMDB for a metabolomics report.
output: A concise metabolite profile with HMDB identifier guidance, formula, molecular weight, synonyms, specimen locations, and pathway context.
A note to verify spectra and concentration fields against the current HMDB entry before publication.

output_examples.input: Compare three MS candidate metabolites from a urine sample.
output: A ranked comparison using mass agreement, available MS or MS-MS spectra, urine relevance, pathway fit, and external database links.
A short uncertainty section explaining which candidates need further experimental confirmation.

output_examples.input: Plan bulk HMDB extraction for a local metabolite database.
output: A practical plan choosing XML for comprehensive records and CSV or TSV for tabular analysis.
A field checklist covering identifiers, chemical properties, spectra, pathways, disease links, concentrations, and provenance.

best_practices: Verify metabolite identifications with multiple evidence types, including spectra, mass, structure, and biological context.
Record the HMDB version, entry identifiers, and access date when using database results in research.
Use bulk downloads for large analyses instead of repeated web queries.
anti_patterns: Treating predicted spectra or sparse fields as confirmed experimental evidence.
Using HMDB biomarker associations as clinical conclusions without independent validation.
Scraping HMDB pages when bulk downloads or authorized programmatic access are more appropriate.

faq.question: What is HMDB?
faq.answer: HMDB is the Human Metabolome Database, a public resource for metabolites found in the human body.

faq.question: Can this skill search by structure?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes structure-based searches using SMILES, InChI, molecular weight, and related chemical fields.

faq.question: Does HMDB provide a public REST API?
faq.answer: The skill states that HMDB does not provide a public REST API. Programmatic access requires contacting the HMDB team.

faq.question: Which data formats does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers XML, SDF, FASTA, TXT, CSV, and TSV downloads from HMDB.

faq.question: Can this skill support biomarker research?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides review of disease links, concentration ranges, specimen types, and supporting references.

faq.question: Is this a clinical decision tool?
faq.answer: No. It supports research workflows and database interpretation, but clinical decisions require qualified review.
